days.lab_task: Map a supplied feature from backlog item through code review, automated checks, staging deployment and release decision. Define acceptance criteria, owner, evidence and rollback trigger for each stage.
days.deliverable: Delivery workflow board, definition of done and release-evidence checklist
days.assessment:
Every workflow stage has an owner, input and evidence output
A failed automated check prevents the release decision from being marked ready
The rollback trigger names a measurable operational condition rather than a vague concern

Identify missing approval and rollback information
